create.name: Suzanne Giesemann
create.bio:
Suzanne Giesemann spent the first part of her working life as a US Navy officer. She reached the rank of Commander, served as a commanding officer and, at the Joint Chiefs of Staff, was aide to its Chairman; she also earned a master's degree in National Security Affairs. Her memoir Messages of Hope, and the documentary that shares its title, follow her path from the military to mediumship, and a second documentary, based on her book Wolf's Message, appeared in 2025.

Today she works as an evidential medium, spiritual teacher and author. Alongside evidential mediumship she teaches The Awakened Way, her name for living in conscious connection with higher guidance, and she passes on channelled messages from a group of guides known as Sanaya. Her practices include the BLESS ME Method, a way of connecting with higher consciousness, and a brief meditation called the SIP of the Divine. Among her more than a dozen books are The Awakened Way, Making the Afterlife Connection and Always Connected. Students can learn through self-paced video courses at her own school and on The Shift Network, and she also offers a free app of daily messages, a live gathering each month, Hemi-Sync recordings and a sizeable YouTube channel.

books.title: The Awakened Way: Making the Shift to a Divinely Guided Life
books.author: Suzanne Giesemann
books.description: Suzanne sets out her path for living in conscious connection with higher guidance. It brings together her stories, channelled teachings and practices such as the BLESS ME Method.

books.title: Messages of Hope: The Metaphysical Memoir of a Most Unexpected Medium
books.author: Suzanne Giesemann
books.description: Suzanne's memoir of moving from a career as a Navy Commander to working as an evidential medium. It follows the experiences that changed her view of consciousness and life after death.

books.title: Wolf's Message
books.author: Suzanne Giesemann
books.description: The true story of a young man, Wolf, and the evidential messages his parents received through Suzanne after his death. The book was later made into a documentary.

books.title: Making the Afterlife Connection: The Journey from Doubt to Knowing That Death Is Not the End
books.author: Suzanne Giesemann
books.description: A look at mediumship and the nature of consciousness, with personal stories and practical tools for connecting with the spirit world.

books.title: Always Connected: How to Find Comfort, Clarity, and Direction from the Spirit Within
books.author: Suzanne Giesemann
books.description: Suzanne combines personal experience and channelled teachings to show readers how to connect directly with higher consciousness in everyday life.

books.title: Mediumship: Sacred Communications with Loved Ones from Across the Veil
books.author: Suzanne Giesemann
books.description: A short guide to soul-to-soul communication with loved ones who have died, drawn from Suzanne's teaching of evidential mediumship.

books.title: Love Beyond Words: 365 Days of Inspiration from Spirit
books.author: Suzanne Giesemann
books.description: A book of daily messages Suzanne received from the guides she calls Sanaya, one for each day of the year.

books.title: In the Silence: 365 Days of Inspiration from Spirit
books.author: Suzanne Giesemann
books.description: A second year of daily channelled messages from Sanaya, written as short readings for reflection.

books.title: The Priest and the Medium
books.author: Suzanne Giesemann
books.description: The true story of medium B. Anne Gehman and her husband Wayne Knoll, a former Jesuit priest, written by Suzanne.

books.title: Where Two Worlds Meet: How to Develop Evidential Mediumship
books.author: Janet Nohavec, Suzanne Giesemann
books.description: Medium Janet Nohavec's systematic approach to developing evidential mediumship, co-written with Suzanne.

courses.title: Making the Connection Level One
courses.description: A self-paced video course, filmed during an in-person class, that teaches a step-by-step process for connecting with spirit. It covers evidence and messages, the ethics of mediumship and the BLESS ME Method across nine modules.

courses.title: Making the Connection Level Two
courses.description: The follow-on course to Level One, for those deepening their mediumship or their personal connection with loved ones and guides. Eight modules with a workbook and downloadable meditations.

courses.title: Personal Mediumship Plus
courses.description: For people who want to connect with their own loved ones and guides without giving readings for others. Nine modules on presence, mindfulness and spirit connection.

courses.title: The Forgotten Center
courses.description: A self-paced course on making clear and reliable connections with spirit, built around Suzanne's stories and evidence. Seven modules plus two bonus sessions of teaching and Q&A.

courses.title: Your Emerging Soul
courses.description: An eleven-module course on seeing life from the soul's perspective and learning to walk in both worlds at once, as a human and a spirit.

courses.title: The Foundations of Evidential Mediumship
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced training on an evidence-based approach to mediumship, for connecting with loved ones in the non-physical realms for yourself and others.

courses.title: Mastering the Mediumship Mindset
courses.description: A ten-module advanced training on the mindset, techniques and daily practices behind accurate mediumship readings. It includes the seven-module introductory programme.

courses.title: Manifest Mediumship Excellence
courses.description: An advanced self-paced training for refining mediumship skills and the artistry of spirit connection.

courses.title: Expand Your Innate Mediumship Skills With Soul-to-Soul Communication
courses.description: An eight-module self-paced course on connecting with loved ones on the other side and other spirit beings, with practices Suzanne calls AHA (Align, Harmonize, Attune).

courses.title: Mediumship & Mastering the State of Flow
courses.description: A self-paced course on deepening intuition and mediumship practice by working from a state of flow.

free_resources.title: Awakened Living (free workshop)
free_resources.description: A free two-hour recorded workshop on living as both a human being and a soul. Suzanne shares teachings, stories and simple tools for staying centred and heart-focused.

free_resources.title: Free Meditations
free_resources.description: A set of free guided recordings, including the 10-minute SIP of the Divine, Journey of Remembrance with channelled music, and a bedtime relaxation.

free_resources.title: Free e-Books
free_resources.description: Two free e-books to read online: Awakening, on Suzanne's journey from scepticism, and a selection of early Messages of Hope poems from Sanaya.

free_resources.title: The Daily Way Message
free_resources.description: A short daily inspirational message from Suzanne and Sanaya, with a searchable archive of past messages.
